metadata.description: Provenance-aware real local commerce dataset covering Dahab safari operators, diving centers, desert guides, watersports, and transport providers with multi-tier verification.

rawSupplierSources.supplierNameRaw: Santa Maria Trips Dahab - سانتا ماريا تريبس دهب
rawSupplierSources.bookingInstructionsRaw: الحجز عبر المنصة أو واتساب الوسيط +201011985293
rawSupplierSources.notes: Promotional excursion flyer listing 13 Dahab/Sinai trips with EGP pricing. No direct supplier contact printed on flyer; booking handled via platform intermediary.

rawSupplierSources.bookingInstructionsRaw: PADI 5-Star Dive Resort & Bedouin camel diving safari operator.

rawSupplierSources.bookingInstructionsRaw: PADI Career Development Centre (CDC) & technical diving facility.

rawSupplierSources.bookingInstructionsRaw: Daily shared departures to Blue Hole, Three Pools, and Sharm El Sheikh Airport transfers.
